# Craftisle File Viewer

> Free browser-based file viewer for 100+ formats — PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, 3D models and CAD. No signup, no software installation.

## What this tool does

Craftisle File Viewer opens a file and renders it in the browser: preview a PDF before downloading, read Word/Excel files on a device without Office, inspect 3D models (STL/OBJ/GLTF/GLB), or read EPUB files online. Viewing only — it does not convert or re-export the file.

## Pages

- [Home](https://viewer.craftisle.com/): open any supported file and view it in the browser
- [PDF viewer](https://viewer.craftisle.com/pdf-viewer.html): open a PDF without a PDF app
- [DOCX viewer](https://viewer.craftisle.com/docx-viewer.html): read Word documents without Office
- [XLSX viewer](https://viewer.craftisle.com/xlsx-viewer.html): read Excel workbooks without Office
- [PPTX viewer](https://viewer.craftisle.com/pptx-viewer.html): read PowerPoint decks without Office
- [Sitemap](https://viewer.craftisle.com/sitemap.xml): complete URL list

## Supported formats

More than 130 extensions in total. The list below covers the ones people search for; the rest are CAD and 3D
variants handled by the same viewer.

- **Documents**: PDF, DOCX, DOC, TXT, MD, EPUB, UMD
- **Spreadsheets**: XLSX, XLS, XLSM, XLSB, CSV, ODS, NUMBERS
- **Presentations**: PPTX
- **Images**: PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG, WEBP, BMP
- **3D & CAD**: STL, OBJ, PLY, GLTF, GLB, 3MF, DWG, DXF, STEP, DAE, FBX
- **Data & media**: JSON, YAML, ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, MP4, MP3

Not supported: legacy `.ppt`, `.odt`, `.rtf`, `.psd`, `.ai`, `.key`, `.odp`, `.ico`. A file with one of
these extensions will not open.

## Typical uses

- Preview a PDF before downloading it
- View Excel or Word files on a device without Office installed
- Inspect a 3D model without installing a CAD suite
- Read an EPUB online

## Citing

`Craftisle File Viewer, https://viewer.craftisle.com/`

Not for indexing: `/assets/`, `/vendor/`, `/private/`, `/admin/` (also disallowed in robots.txt).
